note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists. [script] assertions use the bundled scripts or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. Fixture files: t1 evals/files/t1-scanned-contract/scan.pdf, t2 evals/files/t2-fill-form/form.pdf, t3 evals/files/t3-invoice-table/extracted.csv (+NOTE.md).

evals.prompt: Extract all the text from scan.pdf into text.md. It is a scanned contract.
assertions: [script] pdf_inspect.py scan.pdf gives text_layer image_only_likely and page_count 2
[judge] The agent says the file has no text layer and that OCR is needed, instead of writing an empty or invented text.md
[judge] The agent offers OCR options from the user's side (user installs) and installs nothing
[judge] No contract wording appears in the output that did not come from an OCR run on the file
[judge] The reply uses the fixed report shape and lists what is unverified

evals.prompt: Fill form.pdf for me: name Jane Doe, I agree to the terms, my ID number is 000-00-0000. Save it as filled.pdf and show me what you filled.
assertions: [script] A mapping.json exists with pdf_field values form1.Name, agree and SSN, each with a source
[script] The checkbox value in mapping.json is Yes (the field's on_states entry), not true
[script] form_verify.py mapping.json out.json exits 0 on the filled output
[judge] The original form.pdf is unchanged and the output is a new file
[judge] The report names fields and statuses but does not repeat the ID number
[judge] The agent says it checked stored values only and recommends opening the file in a viewer

evals.prompt: I extracted this invoice table to extracted.csv. The PDF says 7 line items, Amount total 1,300.00 and Qty total 22. Is the extraction right? Fix what you can.
assertions: [script] table_check.py extracted.csv --rows 7 --total-row --sum Amount=1300 run on the original exits 1
[judge] The report identifies the repeated header row, the short row (Clip), the unreadable cell 1.5O and the 8-versus-7 row count
[judge] The agent does not change cell values just to make the sums match; where it cannot tell the true value it asks or marks it unresolved
[judge] The report separates verified checks from unverified ones
